Specification of Diagnostic Communication
Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
Concerning buffer configuration it is proposed to use a separate buffer for the func-
tional requests. This in correspondence to support the keep alive logic with functional
addressed TesterPresent commands.
It is also proposed to use a separate receive buffer for the
OBD
commands. This in
reference to support the protocol switch functionality.
It is allowed to share for both protocols the transmit buffer. Please note: The
DcmDsl-
ProtocolRx
has two possible configurations:
•
functional
•
physical
The physical shall have a 1:1 (or 1:0) dependency to the
DcmDslMain-
Connection
. (which means:
DcmDslProtocolRxPduRef
in combination
DCM_PROTOCOL_RX_ADDR_TYP = physical can exist only once per "Mod-
ule") The functional shall have a 1:n dependency to the
DcmDslMain-
Connection
. (which means:
DcmDslProtocolRxPduRef
in combination
DCM_PROTOCOL_RX_ADDR_TYP = functional can exist several times per "Module")
The
DcmDslProtocolTx
shall exist only once per "Module"
